thread:
Anna: Quick follow-up from the private endpoints RFC: we're still seeing short drops during ephemeral IP rotations (default 6h). Any mitigation ideas?
Raj: Confirmed. Rotation is 6h by default for the ephemeral pool. The issue looks like a timing gap between the agent applying local routes and the controlplane acknowledging the new mapping.
Tim: Could we emit a tiny handoff event so Console/alerts can correlate the drop windows? Even a started/completed marker would help.
Maya: I like that. Simple schema: tenant, old_ip, new_ip, state (started/completed), ts. Keep it strictly telemetry-only.
Anna: How does it get to CP? Agent POST to cp/audit-topic? Concern about widening controlplane surface in private deployments.
Raj: Proposal: agent signs and posts a minimal handoff record to cp/audit. Auth uses existing agent certs. Store for short retention (7d) and fan out to analytics topic. Scrub any PII.
Tim: Important: non-blocking. Agent must retry a few times but not stall rotation. If CP unreachable, write fallback to local log shipping (so we can stitch).
Maya: Implementation notes: 3 retries with exponential backoff, then local fallback. Add per-tenant rate limit (default 1 handoff/min) to avoid storms during mass rotations.
Anna: DNS-based option? Lower TTL to 30s during rotation inside tenant VPC to reduce outage surface. Drawbacks: cache behavior and long-lived TCP sessions remain problematic.
Raj: Avoid DNAT - too risky and complex. DNS approach is safer but client-dependent.
Tim: Pseudo for emission:
POST /cp/v1/tenant/handoff
{
  "tenant_id":"tid-042","old_ip":"10.0.4.2","new_ip":"10.0.9.3","state":"started","ts":"2026-03-21T12:01:02Z"
}
Maya: Console changes: per-tenant "endpoint events" timeline and alert rule: if handoff + error rate spike > X% in 60s, page SRE.
Anna: Actions: Raj -> PR with schema + 7d retention + security scrub note. Tim -> agent best-effort emit + local fallback. Maya -> Console mock and alert rules. Raj: include rate limit config and opt-out flag for tenants.
deploy-bot: Created issue #7821 "ephemeral-handoff-events" and assigned to Raj.
Anna: Cool, will drop affected tenant traces after lunch for validation.
